about: Results from the literature that the paper cites without proof and that the Lean proof uses in formalized form (AlgebraicAnalysis). Keys are `BibKey:locator`, with the bibliography keys of the paper. Locators and their status come from the paper's citation ledger (generalized-stafford docs/manuscript/citation-ledger.md, 2 November 2026); `status` repeats its verdict. Which results use each citation is computed from Lean's dependency graph (verification/lean-dag/graph.json). Mathlib facts used only generically are not listed.

GabrielRentschler1967; McConnellRobson20.claim: Krull (deviation) dimension: descending chains have all but finitely many factors of smaller dimension
GabrielRentschler1967; McConnellRobson20.status: McConnell–Robson locators checked; the 1967 note was not available

McConnellRobson2001:6.2.4.claim: submodules and quotients of M have Kdim ≤ Kdim M (the monotone half of K(M) = sup{K(N), K(M/N)})

McConnellRobson2001:6.2.10.claim: a nonzero module with Krull dimension has a critical submodule; iterated, a Noetherian module of finite Kdim has a critical filtration

Goldie1960:Thms4.1,4.4; McConnellRobson2.claim: Goldie's theorem: in a simple right Noetherian ring the regular elements form a right Ore set, with classical right quotient ring Q; a right ideal containing a regular element has Goldie-torsion quotient

McConnellRobson2001:Ch2§2.claim: uniform (Goldie) dimension, and the Goldie rank length_Q(M ⊗_R Q)

McConnellRobson2001:1.6.9.claim: a filtered ring whose associated graded ring is Noetherian is Noetherian
McConnellRobson2001:1.6.9.status: locator checked; the source is one-sided, the other side by the opposite filtration

McConnellRobson2001:6.5.6,6.4.8.claim: K(S) ≤ K(gr S), and K = classical Krull dimension for commutative Noetherian rings

McConnellRobson2001:1.3.5.claim: A_n(k), char k = 0, is a simple Noetherian domain; its Bernstein filtration bounds Kdim (the exact value n, 6.6.15, is not needed)
McConnellRobson2001:1.3.5.status: locator checked; the centre k follows from 1.3.4

McConnellRobson2001:15.4.5,15.4.7; Bavul.claim: D(X), X smooth affine in characteristic zero, is simple Noetherian, and gr D(X) ≅ Sym_A Der_k(A) bounds its Krull dimension by 2 dim X
McConnellRobson2001:15.4.5,15.4.7; Bavul.status: locators checked; Bavula's journal numbering not rechecked

PBW; McConnellRobson2001:1.6.9,6.5.6.claim: a quotient of U(𝔤), 𝔤 finite-dimensional, is Noetherian with Kdim ≤ dim 𝔤
PBW; McConnellRobson2001:1.6.9,6.5.6.status: no locator for PBW in the ledger
